title: How to Make a Sandwich
description: Practise instructions and joining words, then explain how to make a sandwich.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: We use "First" to start the instructions.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Please ___ your hands before you cook.
exercises.explanation: Instructions use the base verb: wash your hands.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Spread the butter on the bread.
exercises.explanation: Start with the verb: Spread the butter on the bread.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Cheese is uncountable, so we use "some".

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Cuts the tomato into thin slices.
answers: Cut the tomato into thin slices.
exercises.explanation: In instructions we use the base verb: Cut, not Cuts.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: It is a good idea to use fresh bread.
exercises.explanation: "Should" + base verb gives advice: You should use fresh bread.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Put the cheese on the bread. ___ , add the lettuce.
exercises.explanation: "Then" shows the next step.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: A knife is a thing ___ we use to cut food.
exercises.explanation: Use "which" or "that" for things.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: The soup is too hot to eat.
exercises.explanation: too + adjective + to + verb: too hot to eat.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "any" in negative sentences with plural nouns.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My sandwich is more big than yours.
answers: My sandwich is bigger than yours.
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives take -er: bigger than.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: If you add too much butter, the bread ___ too oily. (be)
exercises.explanation: If + present simple, then will + verb.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: We put things on a plate.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: This sandwich is bigger than that one.
answers: That sandwich is smaller than this one.
That one is smaller than this sandwich.
exercises.explanation: Swap the two things and change bigger to smaller.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Look! I ___ just made a sandwich. (have)
exercises.explanation: Use have + just + past participle: I have just made.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + should + base verb: You should wash the lettuce.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: When Dad came in, I ___ a sandwich.
exercises.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress: was making.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: An adverb tells us how: carefully, not careful.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: Mia plans to make a cheese sandwich.
answers: Mia is going to make a cheese sandwich.
exercises.explanation: Use is going to + base verb for a plan.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Linh is the girl ___ made the sandwiches.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" or "that" for people.

task.prompt: Your friend wants to make a sandwich. Write how to make your favourite sandwich.
task.modelAnswer:
How to make a cheese sandwich

You need two slices of bread, some butter, cheese and a tomato.

First, spread the butter on the bread. Then put the cheese and the tomato on one slice. Next, put the other slice on top. Finally, cut the sandwich in half.

You should wash the tomato first. Enjoy your sandwich!
